verdict.rationale: Bevy offers many official examples with viewable source [bevy-docs-16, bevy-docs-22, bevy-docs-34], in-depth reference docs [bevy-docs-27] and crawlable docs.rs API docs [bevy-probe-rt-2], and users report "lots of examples" [bevy-comm-17]. The stability side of the story largely fails, though: it is pre-1.0 with breaking changes every release [bevy-probe-rt-1, bevy-comm-10], needs per-version migration guides [bevy-docs-15], and users report limited docs beyond the book [bevy-comm-14], so models trained on older APIs are likely to produce code that does not compile. Missing for 10: stable non-breaking APIs, evidence that LLM-generated code works on the first try, richer narrative docs, llms.txt or other AI-oriented docs [bevy-probe-1].
